source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.7.2, printed page 111 (PDF 114).

blocks.text: Ester dheere dheere hydrolyse ho kar (paani se toot kar) carboxylic acid aur alcohol (ya phenol) deta hai. Reaction acid ya base se catalyse hota hai (tez hota hai). Aliphatic esters ki hydrolysis is chapter mein pehle (23.4.1) aa chuki hai. Aromatic esters bhi isi tarah hydrolyse ho kar aryl carboxylic acids aur alcohols ya phenol dete hain.

blocks.alt: Do mua'adle, teer ke oopar H+ / OH-. Ethyl benzoate (ring par C(=O)-O-C2H5) + H2O se benzoic acid (ring par C(=O)-OH) + C2H5OH, ethanol. Methyl benzoate (ring par C(=O)-O-CH3) + H2O se benzoic acid + CH3OH, methanol.
blocks.caption: Ethyl benzoate aur methyl benzoate ki hydrolysis (kitab ke PDF safha 114 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ethyl benzoate paani ke saath benzoic acid aur ethanol deta hai, aur methyl benzoate benzoic acid aur methanol. H⁺ (acid) ya OH⁻ (base) catalyst hai. OH⁻ ke saath pehle benzoate salt banta hai jo acid dalne par benzoic acid deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki hydrolysis equations mein baen taraf paani (H₂O) nahi likha, halan ke hydrolysis mein paani hi istemal hota hai; khaake mein '+ H₂O' shamil hai. Labels 'ethylbenzoate' aur 'methylbenzoate' alag alag likhe jate hain: ethyl benzoate, methyl benzoate.

blocks.prompt: Methyl benzoate ko dilute acid se hydrolyse karne par kya products milte hain?
blocks.explanation: Benzoic acid, C₆H₅COOH, aur methanol, CH₃OH.

items: Ester + paani → carboxylic acid + alcohol (ya phenol); acid ya base catalyst.
Ethyl benzoate → benzoic acid + ethanol; methyl benzoate → benzoic acid + methanol.
